title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: choose which AI apps the generative AI apps indicators monitor
notes: claim 48: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The documented app-selection controls, defaults and billing prerequisites check out. Hold the briefing because it asserts an unpublished guarantee that the setting adds no charge, and extends the documented exclusion of app signals into broader guarantees about alerts, risk scores, data access and user experience.

claims.claim: The app-selection route in Microsoft Purview is Insider Risk Management > Settings > Policy indicators > Generative AI apps indicators > Choose apps to monitor.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Purview portal, go to Insider Risk Management > Settings > Policy indicators. ... Expand Generative AI apps indicators. ... select Choose apps to monitor.

claims.claim: No Security & Compliance PowerShell cmdlet or Microsoft Graph operation is documented for setting the generative AI app selection.
claims.quote: Searched: exchangepowershell Insider Risk Management generative AI app selection policy indicators; graph/api insiderRisk settings. Opened policy-indicators page; reviewed Learn search results. No app-selection operation found.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The global generative AI indicators are configured in Microsoft Purview at Insider Risk Management > Settings > Policy indicators > Generative AI apps indicators.
claims.quote: To enable policy indicators for all insider risk policies ... Select Settings, then select Policy indicators. ... Select one or more policy indicators.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or Microsoft Graph operation is documented for configuring Insider Risk Management indicator settings.
claims.quote: Searched: exchangepowershell Insider Risk Management policy indicators Set-InsiderRiskPolicy; graph/api insiderRisk settings. Opened policy-indicators page and reviewed module/Graph-targeted Learn results; no operation found.

claims.claim: All global indicators are disabled by default.
claims.quote: All global indicators are disabled by default; you must select one or more indicators to configure an Insider Risk Management policy.

claims.claim: Role-group membership is configured in Microsoft Purview at Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > Insider Risk Management > Edit > Choose users.
claims.quote: Select Settings ... select Roles and groups, then select Roles groups ... Select the Insider Risk Management role group, then select Edit. ... Select Choose users

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Insider Risk Management" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to that role group in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.claim: Pasting sensitive data into a deselected app raises no Insider Risk Management alert.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management app deselection no alerts risk score sensitive data pasted browser exfiltration. Opened policy-indicators and policy-templates pages; neither establishes exclusion from every Insider Risk Management detection route.
claims.fix: Replace 'so a user who pastes sensitive data into it raises no Insider Risk Management alert and adds nothing to their risk score' with 'so these generative AI apps indicators no longer process that app's signals'. The cited policy-indicators page documents that narrower effect.

claims.claim: Pasting sensitive data into a deselected app adds nothing to the user's Insider Risk Management risk score.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management app deselection no alerts risk score sensitive data pasted browser exfiltration. Opened policy-indicators and policy-templates pages; no statement rules out contributions through other indicators.
claims.fix: Use the same narrowed replacement for the coverage sentence: 'A deselected app's prompts and responses are not processed by these generative AI apps indicators.' Do not promise zero risk-score contribution across Insider Risk Management.

claims.claim: Detection by the Risky AI usage policy contributes to user risk scoring in Adaptive Protection.
claims.quote: Detection of risky activity by this policy also contributes to the user risk scoring in Adaptive Protection.

claims.claim: No new data is read by this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management app selection no new data read no action users apps end user experience. Opened policy-indicators page; it describes selecting signals to process, not a guarantee about all data read by the setting.
claims.fix: Remove 'No new data is read:' and begin the bullet 'The setting narrows which apps' interactions are processed.' Keep the documented explanation that deselected app signals are not processed.

claims.claim: The feature takes no action on users or apps.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management app selection no new data read no action users apps end user experience. Opened policy-indicators and policy-templates pages; neither expressly guarantees no action on users or apps.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the feature takes no action on users or apps.' with 'The documented setting includes or excludes individual apps from monitoring.'

claims.claim: The app-selection setting adds no charge of its own.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management AI app selection pricing additional charge feature choosing apps monitoring cost. Opened policy-indicators, configure and billing-models pages; no statement that the selection setting itself has no charge.
claims.fix: Replace the cost rationale with 'Low. Plan for admin time to review app selection; deselecting apps can reduce existing data security processing unit charges because Microsoft says their signals are not processed and incur no cost.' Do not assert that Microsoft has stated there is no separate setting charge.

claims.claim: Users of the AI apps see no change from app selection.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management app selection no new data read no action users apps end user experience. Opened policy-indicators page; it documents monitoring exclusions but does not state the resulting end-user experience.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with the assessment 'Low. Expect the operational impact to fall mainly on administrators reviewing app selection and analysts interpreting monitoring coverage.' Remove the guarantee that AI app users see no change.
